svg.title: Aditya Kumar Singh — developer profile
svg.desc: Hi, I'm Aditya Kumar Singh: Full-Stack, Python/Django and Data Engineering developer from Dehradun, India. B.Tech CSE at DIT University (2027); former Data Engineering Intern at Celebal Technologies.

g.text: I build data-driven, production-ready apps: Django & Node.js APIs,
real-time ETL pipelines, ML models and secure CI/CD.
